title: The Philistines Capture the Ark of God
description: The Philistines take the Ark of God and bring it to Ashdod, where they place it beside their god Dagon in his temple. Two mornings in a row, they find Dagon fallen face down before the ark, eventually with his head and hands cut off. Then the hand of the Lord strikes Ashdod, Gath, and Ekron with boils and deadly terror, and the Philistine rulers decide that the ark must be sent back to Israel.
